name: Gallery 54
headline: Safari Rally Photography
intro: Sun, dust, revving engines, suspension breaking rocks, and lots of sideways action... This is The Safari Rally. Photographed by Gallery 54
about: Gallery 54 is a photography gallery working across the visual arts. We have followed the Safari Rally since 2024.
Every rally gets its own chapter on this page. Prints, commissions, licensing and press requests are welcome.

2024.blurb: Our first rally. Speed, sun, dust and unpredictable terrain.

2025.blurb: Back on the same roads with a bit more experience and a lot more dust.

2026.blurb: The latest chapter. Dust is still constant.
